requirement: Moving the boot chain to the background must keep the audio-orch cache-first boot invariant: at every startup the local cache loads in full before any remote access. See REQUIREMENTS_20260926_AUDIO_ORCH_QUEUE_STATE_DRIVEN R6 and §5.4, and the restore_from_cache docstring 'before any remote intake'.
evidence: The ordering now relies on timing. Nothing gates it. pycore/pyctl/runtime/event_handlers.py:485 only starts the boot-chain thread. Right after it, :489 apply_assist_runtime(assist_settings) runs on the main thread: pycore/pyctl/assist/capability_sync.py:96-100 enables the lane heartbeat callbacks and calls _apply_lane_lifecycle -> :40-41 worker.request_start() -> pycore/pyctl/laravel/worker_base.py:864-871 request_pull(prefer_remote=True). That is an immediate remote pull. The poll_diff_once callback (worker_base.py:411-440) also does remote diff/pull, with no restore check. pycore/pyutils/tts/audio_queue_center.py:721-726 _restored is only a claim flag: it is set before load_snapshot (:741-743), and no reader waits on restore completion. Remote intake and the debounced persister (flush_dirty :807-826, which writes the ENTIRE in-memory Queue) can therefore run while the 76 MB snapshot is still loading or before push_many lands. Recommended fix (pycore): a per-lane restore-complete gate that remote intake/request_start wait on or skip until set, or run apply_assist_runtime's lane starts at the end of the boot-chain thread.

requirement: Code-as-documentation consistency for the R2 change: the runtime_profile module contract must describe background pinning (AGENTS.md: code is documentation).
evidence: pycore/pyutils/tts/runtime_profile.py:4-5 still says 'Computed ONCE at pyservice startup (pycore_module_caller pins it before any service starts)', and :22-25 says 'the worker pins THIS profile right after; without the flag the profile pins directly at startup'. Both contradict pycore/pycore_module_caller.py:253-258, which pins in a background thread while the RPC server and tray bind. Only the docstring is stale; the behavior is correct.

requirement: M7/§5.4: fix the heavy hot paths. Head preview without a full heap sort, a maintained Part1 count, and a word-audio cache index loaded in full at boot so cache lookups are O(1), with no directory scan per task run.
evidence: Done: audio_task_queue.py:405-457 (_smallest heap-root walk, part_view with the cached _part1_count) and word_audio_cache.py:113-226 (WordAudioCacheIndex.load_all, lookup_many). Gap: note_stored (word_audio_cache.py:204-212) returns early when the language mapping is None. (1) A language directory created after boot is never indexed, so find_cached_many (:246-290) falls back to a full directory scan on every call. (2) A file stored while load_all is still scanning that language (before _install) is dropped from the index, so orchestration gets a miss and generates the word again. pycore/ is in flight (D1 closeout, then the D7 lane); schedule after that.

requirement: R6/§5.4: at every pycore startup, load the local cache in full BEFORE any remote access for every lane whose switch is ON. Also load the word-audio cache index in full in the background.
evidence: The index load and per-lane activation exist (event_handlers.py:430-440). But the boot chain runs as a background bus task (event_handlers.py:485), and apply_assist_runtime(assist_settings) (:489) enables the lane heartbeat callbacks right away. Nothing in laravel_audio_worker*.py waits for restore_from_cache, so the Laravel intake can run before a large snapshot restore finishes. The UI control path, by contrast, activates synchronously first (task_center_service.py:88-91). Whole-Queue dedup limits the damage, but 'cache before any remote access' is not guaranteed. pycore/ is in flight; schedule after the D1/D7 lanes.

requirement: R2/acceptance 2: each missing resource's state advances visibly through missing, queued in Part1, generating, cached, and synced to Laravel.
evidence: Per-item tracker states stop at queued, processing, done and failed (audio_queue_center.py:80-85; contract audio_lane_state.tracked_states). The 'synced to Laravel' stage exists only as task-level aggregates (orch_service.py:419-420 progress.synced and sync_pending, rendered in OrchTaskList.tsx:240-257), not per item in the lane or owner view. The per-item synced state must come from pycore first (tracker or owner view), then be rendered in PcAudioLaneQueueView. pycore/ is in flight.

requirement: Acceptance 5: with a lane switch ON, startup loads the local cache in full first and then pulls the server data in full in the background; with Laravel offline the cached state still renders and drains.
evidence: Offline drain is supported: full-sync and local tasks skip the claim (build_local_task _local_source; prune_absent keeps them, audio_task_queue.py:258-266), and delivery goes through the outbox. The cache-first ordering at boot is not enforced (AOQSD-19: background boot chain at event_handlers.py:485 while apply_assist_runtime at :489 enables the lane intake). Runtime is unverified.

requirement: Acceptance 7/R7: counts for the same quantity match across the Queue Center, the orchestration task and the Laravel listing (one source per quantity).
evidence: The Queue Center lane view and the task progress share one tracker (audio_queue_center.lane_view and owner_counts; orch_service.py:410-413), and the push and snapshot share one builder (snapshot_service.py:654-677). But Laravel's without_audio totals are collected into full_sync.languages[].without_audio (audio_lane_full_sync.py:158) and never rendered: PcAudioLaneFullSyncRow.tsx:59-72 shows only pulled, inserted and queue_count. The word panel's 'Laravel backlog' pending comes from the section contract (PcWordAudioPanel.tsx:35-36), not the listing. No surface puts the Laravel listing count next to the mirrored Part2 count, so a match cannot be checked.
